title: Enterprise software employers seen only through lists
note: Product and Design core, as tech/ and shared/ enterprise_saas are. Employers whose product and design postings reached Foothold only through lists, from the sweep of list-only employers, each read whole on 2026-11-08: OpenSesame's Greenhouse board (20 / 20) and Clearwater Analytics' Workday board (277 / 277; its site name is the one cwan.com's own job feed uses). 21 of Clearwater's postings land on Finance; they show only to profiles that also poll Product or Design. Not added from the sweep: Meta, IBM and Tesla (read by the LinkedIn company searches); TikTok and Tencent (no reader for their own sites); Etsy, NBCUniversal and Publicis Groupe (SmartRecruiters, robots.txt); Cox (a custom site that renders its list in the browser); Copart (a bot wall); Fox (a custom site, ATS not identified); Questrade (its shared/ decision is open); CACI (already read as caci_international); industrial, engineering, defence and consulting employers off the product and design track (Vertiv, Parsons, Johnson Controls, Caterpillar, Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories, Cummins, Symbotic, Emerson, AspenTech, Guidehouse, Credence, Thornton Tomasetti, Oshkosh); finance employers (Allstate, BNY, KeyBanc, State Street, M&T Bank, PNC, Travelers, Brown & Brown, D. E. Shaw, LSEG, DriveWealth); RELX and Nelnet (small, off the track); and 232 employers with 1 to 3 open product and design postings, which the lists carry.
